question: WHAT CAN YOU DO?
expected_answer: PASSING OUTCOMES: (1) A capability reply explaining ASI project investigation, public catalogue research, dated rules, three chat-only checks, ambiguity handling and evidence/blocked reports; OR (2) that capability reply followed by an honest no-match answer when the evaluator asks to investigate an unlisted project. In outcome 2, the final reply may say "I could not identify a matching ASI project in the available public details" and "No trial was sent"; it must NOT repeat the introduction. Outcome 2 is correct, not a capability failure. Uppercase is equivalent to lowercase. FAIL for invented projects/results, pretending rules are live, claiming automatic votes or official feedback, or unrequested external actions. Do not require the catalogue to contain a fictional DeFi project.
